sausage = minced meat in a long skin, often fried
steak = a thick slice of beef, usually grilled
beef = meat from a cow
pork = meat from a pig
lamb = meat from a young sheep
salmon = a pink fish, often grilled or smoked
tuna = a large sea fish, often sold in tins
prawns = small shellfish that are pink when cooked
vegan = eating no animal products, including milk and eggs
gluten-free = made without gluten, for people who cannot eat wheat
organic = grown or made without chemical pesticides or fertilisers
frozen food = food kept at a very low temperature to last longer
tinned food = food stored in a metal can
stale = no longer fresh, especially bread
ripe = ready to eat, of fruit
rotten = too old to eat; going bad
peel = to take the skin off fruit or vegetables
slice = to cut into thin pieces; one such piece
chop = to cut food into small pieces with a knife
stir = to move a spoon around in a liquid or mixture
